no_adcom_quote.quote: The NDA was not discussed at an advisory committee meeting as there were no specific issues requiring input from the committee.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the moxidectin NDA (NDA210867). The Summary Review states the NDA was not discussed at an AC because there were no specific issues requiring committee input, and the Medical Review confirms there was no Advisory Committee, noting that a special government employee (SGE) parasitology consult was sought instead. There was accordingly no AdComm influence on the approval.
